title: Reuse shared feature labels
statement: As a Product Manager, I can define a label once and reference it from several features, so categories stay consistent as the product grows.
overview: A shared label is a stable entity. Features carry references to it, not repeated display names. The same label may organize built and planned features. Authored label membership is separate from the richer theme records.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Two features assigned the same label reference one shared definition, and each feature may reference multiple labels.
Renaming a shared label changes its displayed name for all assigned features without changing their identities or memberships.
Creating a second label with the same name, ignoring letter case, is rejected and identifies the existing definition.
Assigning a missing or cross-Saga label is rejected without changing the feature plan.
An update omitting labels preserves the existing set, supplying labels replaces the set, and an explicit clear removes all label assignments.
